scene.speaker: oliver
scene.bubble: Oh no! The concert starts in ten minutes and I've forgotten my guitar!
scene.intro: Ten minutes before the big concert, Oliver runs into the hall shouting: 'I've forgotten my guitar!' Ingrid has already checked the lights, Maya has just found a lucky coin, and the drummer hasn't arrived yet. Everything happens at the same time — and that is exactly what this unit is about: things that have JUST happened, things we have ALREADY done, and things that haven't happened YET. Take a deep breath, explorer: the show is about to begin!

data.script: Ingrid: Oliver, the bus leaves at eight o'clock. Have you packed your bag yet? … Oliver: Almost, captain! I've already put in my torch and my camera. … Ingrid: Great. What about your boots? … Oliver: Oops… I haven't found my boots yet. Wait… Kili has just brought them! Good bird! … Ingrid: Perfect. Don't forget your raincoat — it's going to rain. … Oliver: I've already packed it, the green one. … Ingrid: And have you made your sandwiches? … Oliver: Yes! Cheese sandwiches. I've made four. … Ingrid: Four? Okay, see you at the school gate at half past seven!

activities.title: Read about the concert. Write just, already, yet or a participle.

data.text: Oliver has {1} arrived at the concert hall — he is still breathing fast from running! He has {2} his guitar at home, so Kili is flying there to bring it. Ingrid has {3} checked the lights and the microphones twice. The drummer hasn't arrived {4}, but his drums are waiting on the stage. Maya has {5} a lucky coin under the stage and she says it is a good sign. Five minutes later, Kili lands with the guitar — nothing is {6}, and the show can begin!
